coastal.title: B.C. ends wildfire-related state of emergency, offroad vehicle ban to be lifted
coastal.description: B.C.'s forests minister says a province-wide state of emergency has ended, but wildfire risk remains.

kamloops.title: Gregor Robertson challenged on the Broadway Construction project
kamloops.description: Fable Diner and SportChek are just two of the most recent businesses to shutter along Broadway near Main Street as construction continues.

kamloops.title: Summerland’s Twisted Whiskers closing as owner says wildfire added to business struggles
kamloops.description: A Summerland thrift store will permanently close its doors in December, after two difficult years in business and a summer tourism season disrupted by the Bald Range wildfire

kamloops.title: Surrey Six killer loses court battle to have conviction overturned
kamloops.description: In 2014, Red Scorpion Cody Haevischer was convicted of six counts of first-degree murder in the October 2007 killings at Surrey's Balmoral Tower.

kamloops.title: Severe drought conditions prompt new order limiting water use for irrigation in B.C. Interior
kamloops.description: A new water-restriction order has been placed on the Bessette Creek area in the southern Interior of British Columbia, after the province deemed chinook salmon at risk from drought conditions.

kamloops.title: Federal government to match Red Cross donations for Summerland wildfire recovery
kamloops.description: The federal government says it will match donations made to the Red Cross for wildfire recovery efforts in Summerland.

all.title: The where, when and how of fuel treatment decisions
all.description: With a big landscape, a limited budget and a diverse set of community objectives, how do we decide where, when and how fuel treatments are best undertaken to reduce wildfire risks? all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: Another MLA leaves BC Conservative Party as Bruce Banman announces exit
all.description: 'The goal in politics is to make the tent bigger. To listen to the majority. It’s not about left or right. It’s about doing what’s right,' Bruce Banman said in a statement.

all.title: Summerland wildfire that forced thousands out of homes now being held
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service says the blaze is expected to remain within its current perimeter of about 252 square kilometres west of Summerland.

all.title: Judge rejects application by 'Surrey Six' killer to stay convictions
all.description: A B.C. Supreme Court judge has rejected an application by one of the "Surrey Six" killers to stay the convictions against him.

all.title: Jury offers 4 recommendations after inquest into fatal police shooting near Tofino
all.description: Julian Jones, 28, died on Feb. 27, 2021 after he was shot when officers responded to reports of a woman being assaulted and confined in a home in the remote island community of Opitsaht.
